status: Provisional assistant extraction; all final endpoint judgments pending independent review

records.event: Liver enzyme abnormalities; treatment stopped in 4 of 8 patients
records.mechanism_note: Biopsies showed bile-duct antigen expression and infiltrating CAR T cells; authors identify antigen-directed injury
records.limitation: Do not interpret 4/8 cessation as the incidence of all liver events or of grade 3+ events

records.mechanism_note: Explicit absence concerns liver injury in this cohort only
records.limitation: Same publication and target as C01; small cohort; no universal safety conclusion

records.event: Mucosal/cutaneous effects and acute pulmonary edema described as target-mediated
records.dlt: Not established for these events in abstract
records.mechanism_note: Authors explicitly describe these effects as target-mediated; independent causality review pending
records.limitation: Mild target-related injury does not establish severe target-related injury

records.context: Same study as C03; conditioning-associated event family
records.mechanism_note: Abstract attributes these blood-cell effects to conditioning treatment
records.limitation: Separate acute fever/chill also reported; this is not an exhaustive event list

records.n_context: 258 randomized total; treated safety denominator not extracted
records.event: Frequent, generally reversible adverse events; abstract describes acceptable tolerability
records.mechanism_note: General immunologic attribution does not specifically establish injury from normal-tissue EpCAM recognition
records.limitation: Randomized total includes controls; do not use 258 as exposed denominator; full-text review needed

records.context: Phase I; renal and ovarian cancers
records.event: Three neurologic events in two patients; study terminated
records.severity: Grade 2 seizure, aphasia and encephalopathy reported
records.dlt: Not separately established in extracted abstract
records.mechanism_note: Investigators report that subsequent investigation did not identify the toxicity mechanism
records.limitation: Study termination alone does not establish on-target causation

records.mechanism_note: Absence statement is about DLT, not all target-mediated effects
records.limitation: Antibody study cannot establish safety of other ROR1 modalities

records.context: Phase I; hematologic and epithelial malignancies
records.event: Pulmonary DLT followed by fatal respiratory failure in one patient
records.severity: Fatal respiratory event; other reversible pulmonary events also reported
records.mechanism_note: Authors describe substantial lung tumor involvement and cannot exclude recognition of normal lung cells
records.source_location: Results, Toxicity; Discussion; supplementary adverse-event table
records.limitation: Results give 2 reversible grade 4 pulmonary cases, discussion gives 3; reconcile before extracting incidence

records.context: Morgan 2010; metastatic colon cancer case report
records.event: Acute respiratory distress followed by death
records.mechanism_note: Authors propose recognition of low-level ERBB2 on normal lung epithelium; abstract frames this as speculation
records.limitation: Case report demonstrates a serious event, not a population incidence or conclusively proven mechanism

records.mechanism_note: Observed tolerability pertains to this clinical setting
records.source_location: Primary article abstract reproduced by authors' institution, Results
records.limitation: Does not negate Morgan case or imply equal risk across treatment contexts; DOI 10.1200/JCO.2014.58.0225

records.event: Fatal toxic epidermal necrolysis; program halted
records.mechanism_note: Authors judge skin toxicity most probably related to CD44v6 expression
records.limitation: CD44v6-specific antigen cannot be assumed equivalent to gene-level CD44 expression

records.event: Liver-enzyme and vomiting DLTs; skin effects mostly mild
records.severity: Grade 4 liver enzymes and grade 3 vomiting; renal death attribution uncertain
records.mechanism_note: Abstract does not establish target-mediated causation for these DLTs
records.limitation: The fatal epidermal necrolysis cited here occurred in a parallel study, not this cohort; do not double count C11

records.event: Headache and fatigue DLTs in two patients; severe neutropenia also reported
records.mechanism_note: Treatment relationship is reported; target-mediated normal-tissue mechanism is not established by these observations
records.limitation: Do not infer on-target causality from DLT or drug relatedness

records.event: Neutropenic infection and abdominal pain DLTs
records.dlt: Three DLTs: one infection and two abdominal pain events
records.mechanism_note: Specific normal-tissue target recognition is not established in extracted safety results
records.limitation: Related schedule within same publication; not another independent target

records.agent: BNT211 clinical study; CAR-T with or without CARVac
records.event: Two resolving DLTs; authors report no observed cognate on-target/off-tumor toxicity
records.severity: Severe treatment-associated events occurred; specified normal-tissue endpoint absent as reported
records.mechanism_note: Absence refers specifically to on-target/off-tumor injury; it does not mean no DLT or no severe adverse event
records.limitation: Combined treatment groups need separation in a final cohort-level dataset; observation is context-limited
